Test_Case_Name: Test the bdx template with new address and new customer policy numbers while upload everytime with bordereau
Acceptance_Criteria: AC1: Upload the template with address change
Preconditions: BDX template is available in user document folder; User has valid ZIP credentials; BDX and ZIP workflow context is ready

Use the new business template for the address & policy changes and save | 4. Open the bdx template to use import functions | 5. Add all the mandate fields and save the files from step1 to step 9 and send the data to zip using user credentials
Expected_Results: | 1. Should be able to get the template for CNLA | 2. Should be always a new copy to work for the template | 3. User should be able to make policy number changes and address changes with proper valid details | 4. Import all the steps and procedures to the bdx template successfully | 5. User should able to generate the CSV file and send the changes to the zip successfully

Test_Data: template: CNLA; business: new business; address: valid changed address; policy number: new customer policy number; file: generated CSV; destination: ZIP
